name: trade_order_id
description: Unique primary key for trade order fact record

name: order_id
description: Original business order ID from execution engine

name: trade_date
description: Trade execution calendar date - Partition key

name: execution_timestamp
description: UTC timestamp of execution print

name: date_key
description: Foreign key to dim_date (YYYYMMDD)

name: ticker
description: Instrument symbol - FK to dim_tickers, Clustering key

name: portfolio_id
description: Trading portfolio book - FK to dim_portfolios, Clustering key

name: trader_id
description: Executing trader - FK to dim_traders, Clustering key

name: asset_class
description: Asset class (EQUITY, FX, COMMODITY, CRYPTO, ETF)

name: side
description: Order transaction side: BUY or SELL

name: order_type
description: Order execution type: MARKET, LIMIT, STOP_LOSS, STOP_LIMIT

name: execution_status
description: Execution status: FILLED, PARTIALLY_FILLED, CANCELLED, REJECTED - Clustering key

name: quantity
description: Executed transaction volume/shares

name: price
description: Execution unit price

name: notional_usd
description: Total gross notional exposure in USD

name: fee_usd
description: Exchange and broker execution fee in USD

name: slippage_bps
description: Execution slippage against arrival price in basis points

name: is_aggressive
description: Taker flag indicating liquidity removing execution

name: sequence_number
description: Monotonic order sequence number

name: _cleansed_record_hash
description: SHA-256 lineage hash from Lakehouse Silver tier

name: _ingested_at
description: Audit timestamp when record was loaded into BigQuery
